description: Experience the ultimate romantic escape in our elegant Deluxe King Room. Featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with stunning views, a plush king-size bed dressed in premium Egyptian cotton, a cozy seating area, and a luxurious en-suite bathroom with a deep soaking tub. Perfect for couples seeking privacy and indulgence.

Unwind in our spacious Superior Triple Room, designed with modern sophistication. Boasting three separate sleeping areas, a living space with premium furnishings, and a fully stocked minibar. The marble-clad bathroom with a rain shower provides a spa-like experience every morning.

Our Family Suite offers generous space for up to four guests. Enjoy two separate bedrooms, a shared lounge with a 65-inch smart TV, and a kitchenette stocked with refreshments. The panoramic city-view balcony makes this suite an ideal home away from home for families.

The Executive Suite is the pinnacle of comfort, accommodating up to five guests. Features include a grand living room, a private dining area, two opulent bathrooms with heated floors, and a wrap-around terrace. Dedicated butler service is available 24/7 to cater to your every need.

A bright and airy Deluxe Family Room designed for groups of six. Two queen beds and a pull-out sofa ensure everyone sleeps comfortably. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a children's activity kit, and easy access to the hotel's outdoor pool and garden terrace.

Our Penthouse Suite redefines luxury. Spanning the entire top floor, it features a private rooftop terrace with a plunge pool, a gourmet kitchen, a home cinema room, and four lavishly appointed bedrooms. The perfect venue for milestone celebrations or an unforgettable group retreat.

The Grand Residence is our most expansive offering, sleeping up to nine guests across five luxuriously furnished rooms. A private chef, chauffeur service, and dedicated concierge team are included. The sprawling private terrace with a hot tub and city views sets the scene for memories that last a lifetime.

Our Cozy Standard Room is the ideal choice for solo travellers or couples on a budget. Thoughtfully designed with a comfortable queen bed, a modern workspace, smart TV, and a sleek en-suite shower room. Enjoy complimentary breakfast and access to all hotel amenities during your stay.
